geometric_identification: Each P component is an unordered polar pair {H,H^perp} of hyperbolic/non-isotropic projective lines; its point carrier H union H^perp is a dual grid inducing K_{q+1,q+1}.
binary_orthogonality: B^T N=0 over F2 because every W line meets a dual grid in 0 or 2 points
odd_q_binary_rank_conjecture: For odd q, im_F2(B)=ker_F2(N^T). This is verified at q=3,5,7,11 but is not promoted without a cross-characteristic rank proof.
q5: 325 P components are exactly the 325 dual grids from hyperbolic polar-line pairs; B is 156x325 with rational rank 91 and binary rank 65 in the frozen q=5 anchor.
boundary: All-q dual-grid geometry and Gram identity are exact. Odd-q binary spanning remains a finite-anchor conjecture. No q5 distance/equality closure is claimed.
